description: A PostHog scheduled change: a change to a feature flag (enable/disable, add a release condition, update variants) applied automatically at a set time, once or on a recurring schedule.

ApiKey.description: PostHog personal API key (phx_...) with the scopes this resource type needs. Pass it with a dynamic reference such as {{resolve:ssm-secure:/posthog/api-key}} when calling SetTypeConfiguration; never put it in plain text.

BaseUrl.description: PostHog API host. Leave unset for PostHog Cloud US (https://us.posthog.com); use https://eu.posthog.com for PostHog Cloud EU, or your instance URL when self-hosting.

ProjectId.description: ID of the PostHog project the scheduled change belongs to.

RecordId.description: ID of the record to modify, e.g. the feature flag ID.

ModelName.description: Type of record to modify. Only `FeatureFlag` is supported (the default).

Payload.description: The change to apply, as a JSON object (use Fn::ToJsonString) with an `operation` and a `value`. Operations: `update_status` (value: true/false to enable/disable the flag), `add_release_condition` (value: object with `groups`, `payloads` and `multivariate`), `update_variants` (value: object with `variants` and `payloads`).

ScheduledAt.description: ISO 8601 date-time when the change should be applied, e.g. 2026-06-01T14:00:00Z.

IsRecurring.description: Whether the schedule repeats. Only the `update_status` operation supports recurring schedules.

RecurrenceInterval.description: How often the schedule repeats. Required when IsRecurring is true.

CronExpression.description: Cron expression for a recurring schedule, as an alternative to RecurrenceInterval.

EndDate.description: Optional ISO 8601 date-time after which a recurring schedule stops executing.

ExecutedAt.description: When the change was applied (for a one-off change). Unset until it runs.

LastExecutedAt.description: When a recurring schedule last ran.

FailureReason.description: Why the last execution failed, if it did.

Timezone.description: Time zone PostHog evaluates the schedule in (the project's time zone).

UpdatedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the last update.
